head: Cash & Cash Equivalents
description: Currency, bank balances, tills, vaults and highly liquid instruments maturing in 90 days or less.

head: Accounts Receivable
description: Amounts owed by customers, processors, related parties and others from normal operations.

head: Notes, Loans & Interest Receivable
description: Promissory notes, consumer/pawn/title loans and accrued interest or finance charges due within 12 months.

head: Inventory
description: Goods held for sale, in production, or as materials/supplies, plus inventory reserves.

head: Prepaid Expenses & Other Current Assets
description: Costs paid in advance, deposits, short-term investments and tax receivables.

head: Property, Plant & Equipment
description: Tangible long-lived assets used in operations, at cost.

head: Accumulated Depreciation (Contra-Asset)
description: Cumulative depreciation recorded against PP&E; reduces carrying value.

head: Intangible Assets
description: Non-physical assets such as goodwill, licenses, software and trademarks, net of amortization.

head: Investments & Other Non-current Assets
description: Long-term investments, long-term receivables, deferred tax assets and deposits.

head: Industry-Specific Non-current Assets
description: Natural resources (oil & gas properties), trust investments (funeral/cemetery), real estate held, rigs, pipelines and similar.

head: Accounts Payable
description: Amounts owed to suppliers, royalty owners, settlement payables and credit cards.

head: Accrued Liabilities
description: Expenses incurred but not yet paid or invoiced.

head: Payroll Liabilities
description: Wages payable and employee/employer withholdings and payroll taxes due.

head: Sales, Excise & Other Tax Liabilities
description: Sales/use, excise, fuel, tobacco, severance, property, franchise and income taxes payable.

head: Customer Deposits & Deferred Revenue
description: Cash received before goods/services are delivered: deposits, layaway, gift cards, pre-need, billings in excess.

head: Short-term Debt
description: Lines of credit, short-term notes, floor plans and current maturities of long-term debt.

head: Other Current Liabilities
description: Related-party payables, clearing/suspense and other obligations due within 12 months.

head: Long-term Debt
description: Mortgages, bank and SBA loans, bonds and other borrowings due after 12 months.

head: Lease Liabilities (Non-current)
description: Operating and finance lease obligations due after 12 months (ASC 842 / IFRS 16).

head: Other Non-current Liabilities
description: Deferred taxes, asset retirement obligations, trust corpus and other long-term obligations.

head: Capital Stock & Paid-in Capital
description: Corporate stock issued, additional paid-in capital and treasury stock.

head: Owner / Partner / Member Capital
description: Capital contributions and draws for sole proprietors, partnerships and LLCs.

head: Retained Earnings
description: Accumulated profits less dividends/distributions.

head: Other Comprehensive Income & Reserves
description: AOCI, translation adjustments and statutory reserves.

head: Opening Balance & Other Equity
description: System/conversion equity accounts used when setting up books.

head: Sales Revenue
description: Revenue from sale of goods across channels.

head: Service, Fee & Contract Revenue
description: Revenue from services, labor, rentals, commissions, subscriptions and contracts.

head: Industry-Specific Operating Revenue
description: Revenue streams unique to the industry (pawn charges, fuel sales, interment rights, oil sales, contract revenue, rents).

head: Revenue Deductions (Contra-Revenue)
description: Returns, allowances, discounts, rebates and markdowns that reduce gross revenue.

head: Cost of Goods Sold - Merchandise
description: Cost of merchandise sold, purchases and landed-cost components.

head: Cost of Services
description: Direct costs of delivering services, including subcontractors.

head: Industry-Specific Direct Costs
description: Direct costs unique to the industry (cost of forfeited pawn goods sold, LOE, fuel cost, job costs, flip property costs).

head: Direct Labor
description: Wages and burden for workers directly producing goods or services.

head: Direct Materials
description: Materials consumed directly in production or jobs.

head: Manufacturing / Production Overhead
description: Indirect production costs: factory utilities, depreciation, supervision, supplies.

head: Packaging, Fulfillment & Other Direct Costs
description: Packaging and order fulfillment costs included in cost of sales.

head: Inventory Adjustments & Variances
description: Shrinkage, obsolescence, count adjustments, spoilage and cost variances.

head: Salaries, Wages & Payroll Taxes
description: Non-direct compensation and employer payroll taxes.

head: Employee Benefits
description: Health, retirement, workers' comp, training and other benefits.

head: Occupancy
description: Rent, CAM, property taxes and building upkeep.

head: Utilities & Communications
description: Power, gas, water, waste, phone and internet.

head: Advertising & Marketing
description: Promotion, advertising, website and customer acquisition costs.

head: Office & General Administrative
description: Office supplies, postage, dues, meals and miscellaneous admin costs.

head: Professional & Outside Services
description: Accounting, legal, consulting and other outside services.

head: Insurance
description: Business insurance premiums (non-employee).

head: Vehicle, Travel & Delivery
description: Fleet operation, travel and outbound delivery costs.

head: Technology & Software
description: IT supplies, software, POS and cloud costs.

head: Repairs & Maintenance
description: Upkeep of equipment and small tools expensed.

head: Depreciation, Amortization & Depletion
description: Systematic allocation of long-lived asset costs.

head: Taxes, Licenses & Regulatory
description: Non-income taxes, licenses, permits and regulatory fees.

head: Bank, Merchant & Cash Handling Fees
description: Bank charges, card processing, chargebacks and armored car.

head: Bad Debts, Losses & Warranty
description: Credit losses, theft, casualty, fines and warranty costs.

head: Industry-Specific Operating Expenses
description: Operating expenses unique to the industry (compliance, licensing, trust admin, exploration, field costs).

head: Other Income (Non-operating)
description: Interest, dividends, gains and other income outside core operations.

head: Other Expense (Non-operating)
description: Interest expense, losses and other non-operating costs.

head: Income Tax Expense
description: Current and deferred federal, state and foreign income taxes.
